attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Nevada state income tax using hypothetical progressive tax brackets: 2.5% on first bracket, 4.0% on second bracket, 6.0% on third bracket. Thresholds vary by filing status. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($7,500 Single, $15,000 MFJ, $11,250 HOH), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NEVADA - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.nv_agi xdef 0 /result.nv_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.nv_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.nv_bracket_3_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NV tax MFJ; Calculate NV tax with MFJ standard deduction and progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.nv_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto nv_standard_deduction_mfj /result.nv_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.nv_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.nv_agi result.nv_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.nv_taxable_income xdef " NV Taxable Income: $" result.nv_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.nv_taxable_income nv_bracket_3_threshold_mfj f> if nv_bracket_2_threshold_mfj nv_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nv_bracket_1_tax xdef nv_bracket_3_threshold_mfj nv_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- nv_bracket_2_rate f* /result.nv_bracket_2_tax xdef result.nv_taxable_income nv_bracket_3_threshold_mfj f- nv_bracket_3_rate f* /result.nv_bracket_3_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2.5% on $0-$100,000): $" result.nv_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (4.0% on $100,000-$240,000): $" result.nv_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 3 (6.0% above $240,000): $" result.nv_bracket_3_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.nv_taxable_income nv_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f> if nv_bracket_2_threshold_mfj nv_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nv_bracket_1_tax xdef result.nv_taxable_income nv_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- nv_bracket_2_rate f* /result.nv_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2.5% on $0-$100,000): $" result.nv_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (4.0% on $100,000-$" result.nv_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.nv_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.nv_taxable_income nv_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nv_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2.5% on $0-$" result.nv_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.nv_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif endif result.nv_bracket_1_tax result.nv_bracket_2_tax f+ result.nv_bracket_3_tax f+ /result.nv_tax xdef " Total NV Tax: $" result.nv_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
